level_id_bank.verdict: Positional. ARCHETYPE = LIVE PARABOLA, now PRICED (redrawn 2026-07-30). LTP 2,215.1 (+0.87%). The 29-Jul read had to say 'no entry can honestly be quoted' because the only ladder was entirely surpassed and the first support was a single-source SMA 9.6% below with ~17% of unstructured air beneath it. The operator then drew the two REFINED ladders (B 337.10->722.60, C 743.9->1,008.6, 19 rungs verified), and the picture changes materially: THE FIRST SUPPORT IS NOW 2,117.4 (Ladder B 4.618), just 4.4% below, backed by a 1,966-2,117 band (4 sources incl. the daily SMA), then 1,701-1,833 (3 rungs). STILL UNPRICED ON THE UPSIDE: price is above the top rung of BOTH refined ladders (B 4.618 = 2,117.4, C 4.618 = 1,966.3), so there is no fib target overhead -- only the 2,445 July high as a prior-high reference. A third, even more recent leg would be needed to price the extension. WHAT IS NOW TRADEABLE: a pullback to 2,117 has a real level under it and a stop can sit below the 1,966-2,117 band rather than in a vacuum. Structure beneath is dense all the way down (1,833 / 1,731 / 1,701 / 1,568 / 1,537 / 1,437 / 1,346 / 1,304), so this is no longer a mid-air chart. BREAKOUT INVALIDATION unchanged: a daily close below 1,463 (Ladder A 4.115 + daily EMA + operator box) returns price inside the old 1,000-1,450 range. position_status: closed.
level_id_bank.method: level-ID-fib (universal level set) -- ONE monthly base ladder (fully verified rung-by-rung) + three operator demand boxes + MA stack. Plus TWO REFINED ladders (B, C) drawn 2026-07-30 in response to the 29-Jul flag-to-redraw. The flag is RESOLVED for the downside -- the refined ladders fill what looked like a structural void. The UPSIDE remains unpriced: price is above the top rung of both refined ladders too.
